svg.title: ACE Refund Readiness Gates
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-ace-refund-readiness-gates; chapter number: 5; title: ACE Refund Readiness Gates; subtitle: Four checks before a CAPE declaration can pay out by ACH; caption: Since February 6, 2026, CBP pays refunds only by ACH to bank details registered in the ACE portal. Each gate below closes a failure point practitioners have seen.; assumptions note: The gate order follows the setup sequence the speakers walked through. CAPE refund speed estimates range from about 3 business days to 60-90 days.; note: Sources are Scarbrough Global, Ask The Customs Manager, Shapiro, NextGen CPA, TEU Global and BGI Worldwide Logistics, Inc.; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Is the ACE portal account approved and unlocked with the shared secret?; pass next: G2; fail action: Apply with company and IOR details. Three failed attempts lock the account, and a locked-out TAO calls the ACE helpdesk with the shared secret (Shapiro).; gate: G2; question: Are routing and account numbers loaded in the ACE portal itself?; pass next: G3; fail action: Load and double-check bank details. Paying duty by ACH or periodic monthly statement does not register you, and a wrong account sends the refund into the void for months.; gate: G3; question: Are CF28 and CF29 deliveries switched from mail to portal?; pass next: G4; fail action: Select portal plus mail delivery. A three-week mail delay can leave as little as 5 days of the 30-day CF28 window (Scarbrough Global).; gate: G4; question: Is every IEEPA-hit 7501 captured, with its liquidation date tracked?; pass next: Declare in CAPE; fail action: Pull the ES-001 and ES-003 line-tariff reports from 2025 forward and track the 180-day protest clock. A missed entry means a new declaration at the back of the queue (NextGen CPA).

rect.title: gate: G1; question: Is the ACE portal account approved and unlocked with the shared secret?; pass next: G2; fail action: Apply with company and IOR details. Three failed attempts lock the account, and a locked-out TAO calls the ACE helpdesk with the shared secret (Shapiro).

gate: G2; question: Are routing and account numbers loaded in the ACE portal itself?; pass next: G3; fail action: Load and double-check bank details. Paying duty by ACH or periodic monthly statement does not register you, and a wrong account sends the refund into the void for months.

gate: G3; question: Are CF28 and CF29 deliveries switched from mail to portal?; pass next: G4; fail action: Select portal plus mail delivery. A three-week mail delay can leave as little as 5 days of the 30-day CF28 window (Scarbrough Global).

gate: G4; question: Is every IEEPA-hit 7501 captured, with its liquidation date tracked?; pass next: Declare in CAPE; fail action: Pull the ES-001 and ES-003 line-tariff reports from 2025 forward and track the 180-day protest clock. A missed entry means a new declaration at the back of the queue (NextGen CPA).
